== Course of events ==

After the ordeal in the Black Pit, where the new Princess had spared Dorothy, Zeb, and the Wizard while condemning Jim, Eureka, and the piglets, the Wizard of Oz makes his own entrance into the realm beyond by descending in a balloon. There he encounters Gwig, the thorny Sorcerer who holds power over the Mangaboos, and the two engage in a contest of magic. The Wizard defeats Gwig, proving his own skill as a magic-worker among this strange people.

In the course of this confrontation, the Wizard also learns a singular fact about the Mangaboos: rather than being born as other peoples are, they grow from bushes. This discovery marks the Wizard's introduction to the true nature of the vegetable people, setting the stage for the group's arrival in the glass city of the Mangaboos, ruled by a Prince, where Jim and the kitten Eureka would soon unexpectedly gain the power of speech.
